description.value: You can perform a genuine last rite for a mind about to be uploaded into Paradise — not to save them, but to make sure whatever's left afterward remembers it was once a person. Once per day, performing this rite over a willing subject grants them a +2 circumstance bonus to any one save related to mental domination or possession for the next 24 hours, uploaded or not.

cinderfall.incomplete: Granting a willing subject a future +2 save bonus for 24 hours is an effect on another creature's own roll, requiring a granted buff-effect item with a duration -- no such mechanism is established anywhere in this corpus for a skill feat.
